current_state.target: 7 uncovered high-traffic Rijksoverheid assets (non-DEF): globio.info, vananaarbeter.nl, rijksvaccinatieprogramma.nl, netherlandsandyou.nl, nlplatform.com, nederlandveilig.nl, oprijk.nl

recon_enumeration: www.globio.info is WordPress + Divi 4.27.7 (Apache/PHP) with Wordfence and Wordfence Login Security active. GET /?s= reflected the marker only HTML-entity-encoded in <title> and result headings (no raw < or double-quote), so no reflected XSS. wp-json index is 200 but /wp/v2/users returns 401 rest_user_cannot_view (no user enumeration). xmlrpc.php present but pingback-only (NCSC-ineligible). The voldoet=nee CSV value alone does not demonstrate a vulnerability.

www.vananaarbeter.nl is a SEOmatic (Craft-style) React/Redux SPA on a Heroku edge. Saved JS exposes only public geo APIs /api/{autocomplete,geocode_free,reverse_geocode,roads}. HERE map ApiKey is read from an empty data-here-app-key attribute (not exposed). No secret in JS. /api/autocomplete returned 302 downgrading to http:// (proxy quirk; recorded, not followed).

rijksvaccinatieprogramma.nl is Drupal (sdv_theme/bootstrap_rijkshuisstijl). GET /zoeken?search= reflected the marker only inside input value (HTML-encoded) and JSON-escaped in drupal-settings-json = no raw reflection. /jsonapi index is 200; per brief only the index was checked, no resource collection queried.

www.netherlandsandyou.nl: the http:// root probe timed out (curl 28), which does not distinguish a missing listener from filtering or temporary reachability; the https:// root is 200, so the CSV https=nee value does not mean HTTPS is absent. Liferay DXP behind Microsoft-Azure-Application-Gateway/v2. GET /search?q=<marker> blocked 403 by the Azure WAF; benign q=residence returned 200 with the value HTML-encoded in the input (no raw reflection). Liferay JSON WS /api/jsonws returned 404 {} (remote API disabled). Strong CSP/security headers.

www.nlplatform.com returns 301 to apex https://nlplatform.com/ (nginx). The apex is a hostname variant absent from the brief allowlist, so it was recorded and NOT requested (scope decision deferred to supervisor).

www.nederlandveilig.nl and www.oprijk.nl are Platform Rijksoverheid Online Next.js App Router sites (oprijk uses Turbopack). Light fingerprint only per brief. oprijk /zoeken direct GET is 404 (client routing) and the marker appears only unicode-escaped in the RSC __next_f payload. No secrets in sampled chunks.

exploit_foothold.result: None. No POST/PUT/DELETE, authentication attempt, brute force, enumeration, WAF bypass, data copy, or pivot.

failed_attempts_constraints: netherlandsandyou.nl search marker blocked by Azure Application Gateway WAF (403); not bypassed per brief stop condition.
netherlandsandyou.nl Liferay JSON WS remote API disabled (/api/jsonws 404 {}), closing a common Liferay IDOR/info-leak surface.
globio.info /wp/v2/users 401 (no anonymous user enumeration); reflected marker fully HTML-encoded (no XSS).
rijksvaccinatieprogramma.nl and oprijk.nl search reflections are encoded/JSON-escaped (no raw HTML reflection).
vananaarbeter.nl exposes only public geo-lookup APIs; no secret in JS. POST/registration/SSO not permitted in this wave.
unexplored_surface: nlplatform.com apex (canonical redirect target, off the allowlist) needs explicit scope confirmation before any request.
api.rwsverkeersinfo.nl (RWS traffic widget base-url on vananaarbeter.nl) is a separate/third-party host requiring separate authorization.
vananaarbeter.nl /api/autocomplete 302 http downgrade is a minor mixed-content/proxy observation, low impact alone.
Liferay authenticated portlets, Drupal JSON:API resource collections, and WordPress authenticated paths remain deliberately untested; POST-capable/authenticated waves would be required.
considerations_for_next_agent: Read workspace/wave19-core2/notes.md and fingerprint.tsv. Do not repeat these 25 GETs. All seven brief assets are anonymous-GET NEGATIVE (nlplatform is INCONCLUSIVE only because its canonical host is off-allowlist). netherlandsandyou.nl is the most interesting stack (Liferay DXP) but is WAF-fronted with JSONWS disabled; a finding there would need supervisor-approved WAF/auth scope. Treat encoded reflections, version disclosure, and header gaps as NCSC-ineligible without demonstrable impact.
